description: Install or reconfigure the TTS Shared Bmad module — registers help entries + module metadata, copies bundled .claude/* templates into the project (skipping existing files), then offers to chain into /bmad-tts-bitbucket-connect for first-time auth setup. Also supports a focused rules-only refresh ("update rule" / "cập nhật rule" / --update-rules) that syncs just .claude/rules from git. Reuses bmm config; no module-specific values required.
args: {setup or configure: trigger registration}|{update rule / cập nhật rule / --update-rules: refresh only .claude/rules from git, no full setup}|{-H: headless mode}|{--skip-bitbucket: don't offer Bitbucket setup at end}|{--skip-templates: don't copy .claude/* templates}|{--overwrite-templates: replace existing template files}|{--skip-template-sync: don't pull templates from git}|{--template-sync-branch <name>: pull from a non-default branch}

description: Connects the project to Bitbucket (Cloud OR Server/Data Center) — prompts for the API host URL plus an App Password / Access Token / Bearer Token, validates via REST API, and saves credentials to config.user.yaml (gitignored). Flavor auto-detected from URL. Required before design-story-pr or check-review can run.
Generates an implementation-ready detail design document for a story before development. Slots between create-story:validate and bmad-tts-design-story-pr.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{story-path: explicit story file path}

description: Opens a Bitbucket PR from features/{story_key}-dev into features/{story_key} (story integration branch) with techlead/SA reviewers, so the design gets a human gate before implementation continues. Requires bitbucket-connect to have run.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{--story <path>: explicit story file}|{--team <code>}|{--base <branch>: override base}|{--update: refresh existing PR}

description: Checks Bitbucket PR merge/review state for stories awaiting review (design or code) and auto-transitions sprint-status when PRs are merged. Generic across review phases — currently configured for design-review; extensible to code-review. Requires bitbucket-connect to have run.
args: {-H: headless mode}|{--story <key>: single story}|{--transition <id>: restrict to one transition}|{--dry-run: no writes}

description: Full story pipeline orchestrator — detects current stage and chains create-srs → design-story → design-story-pr → check-review → dev-story in sequence. Shows a visual dashboard of pipeline state and lets you run the next step or all remaining steps at once.
args: {--story-key <key>: target story}|{--story <path>: explicit story.md}|{--step <srs|design|pr|review|dev>: force a specific step}|{--next-only: run only the next pending step}|{-H: headless — auto-chain all remaining steps}

description: Convert documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, RTF, ODT, EPUB, CSV, TXT, JSON, YAML, images) to Markdown for the VDS/Viettel stack. PDF diagrams transcribed to inline mermaid (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, ...) where possible.
Generate Kafka consumer factory config + listener stub for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions.
args: {topic: kafka topic}|{group-id: consumer group}|{handler-class: target listener class}

description: Generate Kafka producer boilerplate (KafkaBaseConfig + ProducerConfig + KafkaBaseProducer + Producer) for Spring Boot projects following VDS/Viettel stack conventions.

Generate a Spring REST client service (outbound HTTP integration) following the VDS/Viettel pattern — RestTemplate + @Qualifier, @Value-backed host/product config, HttpHeaders with PRODUCT + AUTHORIZATION, UriComponentsBuilder URL build, restTemplate.exchange with ParameterizedTypeReference, BaseResponseException on failure.

Query SonarQube issues for {project_key}@{branch}, group by severity+rule, then fix in priority order (BLOCKER→CRITICAL→MAJOR→MINOR). Reads creds from config.user.yaml (tts.sonar block, gitignored). Surfaces judgment-required rules for user decision instead of silently refactoring.
args: {--severity <list>: default BLOCKER,CRITICAL,MAJOR — or all}|{--rule <ruleKey>}|{--file <substring>}|{--branch <name>}|{--max <n>: default 200}|{--dry-run}|{--no-fix: triage only}|{-H | --headless: auto-apply safe rules}

description: Hướng dẫn viết PRD theo chuẩn VDS cho dự án Fintech/Tech (tiếng Việt) — orchestrator 6 bước, dẫn user qua từng section, gọi các skill phụ (objectives/metrics/user-stories) khi cần. Output PRD vào planning_artifacts.

args: {viết mục tiêu / phân tích thực trạng / create objectives VDS: trigger}

args: {validate PRD / kiểm tra PRD / review PRD VDS / check PRD: trigger}

description: Kết nối và tương tác Confluence Data Center nội bộ (đa domain sản xuất/đối tác) qua hội thoại tiếng Việt — tìm/tạo/sửa page, đẩy tài liệu Markdown kèm ảnh & mermaid diagram. Runtime là node CLI tự chứa (bin/cli.js) với node_modules vendored sẵn — KHÔNG cần npm install. Token lưu ngoài repo (~/.confluence-vds-skill/domains.json).
args: {kết nối Confluence / đẩy tài liệu lên Confluence / connect confluence: trigger}
